research_notes: A future aggregate can calculate strict clean counts per target and identify the current bracket automatically.
It should treat under-target and non-duration failures as non-boundary evidence exactly as the decision rule specifies.
It should keep supporting parallel evidence in a separate channel.
This will reduce manual state drift as the number of probes grows.
The summary state can then be regenerated from immutable evidence if needed.
Such tooling is supporting development and remains subordinate to the runtime study.
